title: [Settings] Address CA2227 in module view models

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The collection changes keep bound collection instances stable, preserve the existing Image Resizer and Power Display subscription/notification paths, and explicitly save the Mouse Without Borders machine order after a drag. The persistence helper materializes the projected names before replacing the settings snapshot.

The reported save-overload mismatch is not present: `SettingsUtils.SaveSettings` is one three-parameter method with optional arguments, so omitting the third argument supplies the same default filename verified by the tests. The Color Picker preview's clear/add notifications are intentional; its added regression cases cover restoring selection during synchronous collection feedback. No measured performance regression requiring a new bulk-collection abstraction was established.

**Validation scope:** The changed source, dependent save signature and drag/drop caller were inspected. Exact-revision diff checks and changed XAML well-formedness checks passed. The added unit tests were inspected, not independently executed; no Settings UI build or interactive reorder/persistence/selection scenario was run. Those runtime outcomes are not certified by this assessment.

No additional code change is requested by this qualified assessment. It is not an unconditional approval.
